defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses DSU/Kruskal-style selection as though mechanisms can be chosen from an arbitrary graph, rather than recognizing that every edge on each unique critical-to-critical path is mandatory and irrelevant branches must be excluded.
Sorts all mechanisms and applies a global Kruskal strategy, which can include cheap edges outside the critical spanning subtree and therefore does not compute the fixed union of tree paths.
